scope: 1D SVE exact-first ODE solving; separate exact structure proposals from profile approximation
search_method: project-local evidence first; primary source records and metadata second

sources.title: Lie Symmetries and Similarity Solutions for a Shallow-Water Model with Bed Elevation in Lagrange Variables
sources.read_path: ref/large-pdfs/Lie Symmetries and Similarity Solutions for a Shallow-Water Model with Bed Elevation in Lagrange Variables-mathematics-14-00433-v3.pdf
sources.use: Fixes the printed scalar benchmark and source claims about its reductions; it is not accepted as proof of the separately corrected material/Eulerian equivalence.
sources.limits: The manuscript keeps printed P, corrected M, and Eulerian E distinct; do not attribute the project's model correction or exact checks to this paper.

sources.title: Applications of Lie Groups to Differential Equations
sources.use: Infinitesimal symmetry criteria and analytic local existence after ODE specialization; structure candidates require exact identity checks.
sources.limits: These page numbers are edition-specific. This source does not justify neural discovery or global continuation.

sources.title: solve_ivp documentation
sources.access_status: installed_docstring_confirmed; versioned online URL returned 404 in prior recorded check
sources.use: DOP853 is documented as high-precision explicit order-8 for nonstiff IVPs; Radau/BDF are options for stiff cases. Supports an appropriate baseline choice.
sources.limits: The adaptive local error control is not a rigorous global error certificate; validate the SVE solution and reconstruction independently.

sources.title: Characterizing possible failure modes in physics-informed neural networks
sources.access_status: confirmed_full_primary_arxiv_HTML; PDF download timed out in previous bounded retrieval
sources.use: Shows PINN optimization/conditioning difficulty is a real method risk despite approximation expressivity; motivates multiple seeds and failure reporting.
sources.limits: PDE benchmarks, not this SVE ODE; no quantitative SVE performance conclusion.

sources.title: PINNacle: A comprehensive benchmark of physics-informed neural networks for solving PDEs
sources.access_status: confirmed_full_primary_arxiv_HTML; two bounded PDF attempts timed out
sources.use: Supports reporting explicit architecture, optimizer, relative/absolute and Fourier error measures in neural comparisons.
sources.limits: PDE benchmark, not evidence PINNs outperform DOP853 or Chebyshev on a one-dimensional SVE profile. Read version is v2 (2023), not silently the later proceedings version.

sources.title: On the approximation of functions by tanh neural networks
read_anchors: Theorem 5.1, printed p.20 and proof pp.20-26
sources.use: For stated smoothness, existence of two-hidden-layer tanh approximants in derivative Sobolev norms; useful to distinguish representability from fitting.
sources.limits: No optimizer convergence, finite trained-network error, residual certificate, or SVE speedup follows.

sources.title: Universal Differential Equations for Scientific Machine Learning
sources.use: Methodological comparator for hybrid differential models with learned components and sensitivity-aware fitting.
sources.limits: Learning a missing law is different from approximating a profile of a fixed certified ODE; no generic SVE benefit is inferred.

sources.title: Discovering governing equations from data: Sparse identification of nonlinear dynamical systems
sources.use: Relevant exact-structure-adjacent baseline: sparse regression over a declared library can propose governing ODE terms from data; favor comparing against transparent sparse symbolic baselines.
sources.limits: Data-driven equation discovery is not exact Lie symmetry or first-integral certification; noisy derivatives and library misspecification remain. Full theorem/details not reread in this pass.

sources.title: AI Feynman: a Physics-Inspired Method for Symbolic Regression
read_anchors: Section II.5, neural-network-based tests and transformations
Section III, results and method comparison
sources.use: A symbolic-regression precedent for exploiting structure such as separability/symmetry when proposing expressions; a possible candidate-proposal comparator only.
sources.limits: Benchmark/database setting is not exact differential identity verification, nor evidence the method discovers SVE generators or beats SymPy.

sources.title: Lie Point Symmetry and Physics Informed Networks
read_anchors: Section 4, heat and Burgers PDE experiments
sources.use: Closest named prior art for symmetry-aware PINN loss/design; supports treating symmetry constraints as known structure supplied to learning.
sources.limits: Its PDE experiments do not demonstrate exact symbolic classification, ODE order reduction, or speedup for this scalar SVE IVP. Hybrid usefulness remains an empirical question.

anchors: 43 passing tests, 12 classical cases, 40 bounded approximation runs
Sections 1-4: P/M model distinction, common scaling, exact first integral, L != 0 ODE chart
sections 1-5: exact certificate data inputs and explicit non-claim of training or classical advantage

retrieval_limits: The 2026-10-19 source ledger supplies prior local reads of PINNacle, Krishnapriyan, De Ryck, UDE, SciPy and the SVE source; its exact access limits are carried forward rather than silently upgraded.

For AI Feynman, SINDy, and SymPINN, live arXiv metadata and primary HTML availability/section-heading checks were performed on 2026-10-21; this pass did not inspect every proof, appendix, or full benchmark result.
This is a bounded ten-identity source pass at citation depth zero, not an exhaustive prior-art or novelty review.
